items.title: ONLY ONE
items.text: You are declaring your personal bond to Hashem. You are calling to Him because you trust in no other power.

items.title: DIALOG
items.quote: Don’t be deaf to me, lest You [then] be mute to me.
items.text: Beg Hashem not to ignore you, but to interact with you, listening to what you have to say and responding to you. Watch for His response in His actions toward you and in the thoughts that come in to your mind.

items.quote: Hear the sound of my supplications when I cry out to You.

items.title: SHOW OF HANDS
items.quote: I lift my hands towards Your Holy Sanctuary.
items.text: Express emotion in tefillah by raising your hands in your ardor.

items.title: DIFFERENTIATION
items.quote: Don’t draw me along with resha’im, nor with wrongdoers.
items.text: Ask Hashem to keep you apart from wicked people, not to let you be influenced by them and not to let you be absorbed into their calamitous destiny.

items.title: GIVING THOUGHT
items.quote: For they do not give thought to the deeds of Hashem and His handiwork.
items.text: Pay attention to the wonders of the world that Hashem created.

items.title: ANTICIPATION
items.quote: Blessed is Hashem for He has heard the sound of my supplications.
items.text: Thank Hashem even before you have evidence that He has heard you.

items.quote: My heart trusted in Him and I was helped.

items.title: SONGS OF PRAISE
items.quote: My heart exults and I will praise Him with my song:
items.text: Sing out your expressions of praise and gratitude to Hashem so that others will be inspired to follow suit.

items.title: YESHUAH
items.text: Ask Hashem to grant a yeshuah, not only for yourself, but for all of Yisrael.
